deck.title: Constellation — decks from patterns, not from scratch

fill.title: Constellation — decks from patterns, not from scratch
fill.subtitle: Your past decks already contain your future ones — extract the patterns once, compose forever.

fill.title: Before: every deck starts at slide zero, again
body: It's 11pm, the demo is tomorrow, and the deck is still slide zero
Every new deck redraws layouts you have already drawn before
The labor isn't the content — it's rebuilding the same visual grammar by hand

fill.title: Your old decks are a pattern library nobody reads
body: orion-sample: 6 slides, 2 archetypes — the workhorse slide recurs 3×
Same hard grid every time: title band y 5.3%, body y 21.3%, accent bar y 92%
One accent color doing two jobs: heading emphasis + footer wayfinding

fill.title: analyze — a script extracts facts, an agent finds the archetypes
body: extract.py dumps geometry, layouts, and font/color censuses to JSON — deterministic, never interprets
The agent clusters slides into named archetypes; every claim cites slide numbers
An archetype recurring ≥2× becomes a template candidate

fill.title: templatize — archetypes become reusable templates + a design guide
body: Geometry survives, source text is stripped — the privacy wall that keeps real decks private
Appearance binds to theme tokens, never literal values — the theme is the design guide
This very deck's templates were generalized from the 6-slide synthetic sample

fill.title: compose — idea × pattern × theme → final .pptx
body: The brief's per-slide roles match template roles — stretches are marked, never silent
build.py validates every cross-reference, then draws — no improvisation in the renderer
Unresolved material renders as a visible OPEN line, never plausible filler

fill.title: Watch a deck assemble itself
body: This deck is the demo: composed from its own brief with the orion templates
library/decks/constellation-intro/deck-spec.json → build.py → the file you are watching
OPEN: patterns from a real deck will make this prettier — the sample deck is synthetic
